instruction: Candid wedding photograph, medium shot. Outdoors in a mountain landscape with green foliage, a man in a black leather jacket (R1) stands on the left, holding the raised right hand of a woman with long curly hair (R2) with his left hand. The woman, wearing a white leather jacket and lace dress, has her back to the camera as she begins to spin. Soft natural daylight illuminates the scene.
